coarsening_scope: Tangential surface and adjacent volume targets only; protect LE/TE and preserve wall-normal layers. Keep M09 remote-region design separate until its evidence passes.
implementation_gate: Current global foil surface control must be locally overridden by supported edge/surface or volume controls. Verify actual surface-edge lengths and region transitions after generation; blocks alone do not prove surface refinement.
acceptance: No automatic admission. Audit source geometry, layer continuity, closure/volume, y+, local pressure and viscous drag, CFL, step cost and both settled coefficient differences against comparable evidence.
limitation: Cp and pressure-force localization are one accepted field snapshot, not window means. Local viscous-wall traction is not exported, so savings and accuracy cannot be concluded from this study.
estimation_limit: Indicative tangential edge-length scaling; small curvature-limited segments retained. Actual local controls, transitions and mesh counts must be measured.
design_reason: Narrow LE x/c<0.05 and TE x/c>0.85 controls are the initial design. Refining a broad 0–0.15 plus 0.75–1 end region while coarsening the middle nearly cancels the surface-edge saving; it is not an efficient first test.
